bio.text: Dave Smith represents District 38 in the Florida House of Representatives as a Republican, elected in 2018 and reelected subsequently.
Smith is a retired U.S. Marine Corps colonel and UH-1N helicopter pilot, and now works as a business consultant in Winter Springs.
Smith holds a BBA from Texas A&M University (1982) and an M.S. from Florida Institute of Technology (2000). Smith moved to Florida in 1972.
